catalogId.description: The catalogId you are requesting ads for. Typically a single identifier for a retailer.

placement.description: The placement you are requesting ads for.

sessionId.description: Unique sessionId used for attribution. Required to be consistent between a user's session and order reporting.

searchTerm.description: Used for search placements. The exact search term entered by the customer on your site.

targetedProductGtin.description: Used for cross-sell placements. The product code that is being advertised against

maxNumberOfAds.description: The maximum number of product ads to receive.

contentStandardId.description: The banner contentStandardId. Required for banners.

bannerSlotIds.description: The banner slots ads are required. Will be superseded by bannerSlots array object.

productFilters.description: An array or arrays are required depending on your ad generation filtering. Used in category placements or any other placement to further define business rules. Not currently compatible with cross-sell or upsell placements.

filtermode.description: Defines the ad generation filtering mode.

cached.description: Defines if the retailer expects to cache the adId

includeAdvertiserInfo.description: Defines if the retailer requires advertiser information to comply with the EU's Digital Services Act

bannerSlots.description: The banner slots that are requested. Specifying maxNumberOfAds for the banner allows you to retrieve multiple of the same banner slot.

slotId.description: The bannerSlotId ads are required for.

maxNumberOfAds.description: The maximum number of product ads to receive.

segmentIds.description: The list of segment IDs that the customer can access.

sourceId.description: The agreed ID of the source between Epsilon and yourself. Used when multiple sources are used for segments. Not required if only syncing from one source.

id.description: The order ID in the retailer's site. If not provided it is generated by CitrusAd in the response.

sessionId.description: Unique sessionId used for attribution. Required to be consistent between a user's session and order reporting.

orderDate.description: This is the date or the date and time of the order. This must be in the format of ISO-8601 RFC 3339 standard and must be a precise, full timestamp, e.g. 2019-03-14T15:06:17+10:00

gtin.description: The product code of the purchased product.

quantity.description: The quantity (units) of the product purchased.

regularUnitPrice.description: This is regular unit price of the product in the order.  If provided, it MUST be a number.

totalOrderItemPriceAfterDiscounts.description: This is the total price of the products with discounts. It MUST be a number, e.g. if an order item contains 3 items with a price of 2.00, the value will be 6.

sellerId.description: The unique Id of the seller. Only required if onboarding marketplace sellers. Can be left blank for non marketplace products.   There are additional requirements to integrate seller_ids, please refer to [Marketplace sellerId](https://developers.citrusad.com/integration/reference/marketplace-sellerid) for more information.
